ST-08.title: Add automated regression test for numpy-scalar handling

sign_off_record.decision: Approved — both tests pass standalone and in the full 747-test suite, falsifiability independently confirmed, CI trigger path verified; one non-blocking imprecision found (ineffective decimal_to_float patch.object) and fixed same-session

ST-08.notes: Discovered and fixed a real cross-file pytest test-isolation bug during implementation: popping/reimporting sys.modules['services.signal_service'] created a divergent module object that broke test_nightly_computations.py's RX-02/03/05 tests when both files ran in the same session. Fixed by patch.object-ing the existing cached module instead of reimporting. A second, related fix applied after QA review: evicting sys.modules['utils']/['utils.formatting']/['utils.pricing'] correctly (all three needed — utils/__init__.py imports from .pricing) so the local decimal_to_float re-import inside generate_rebalance_exit_signals always resolves to the real implementation regardless of session ordering.
